styles.name: Hymn
styles.description: Slow, three beats to the bar, sustained chords under a stepwise line.

styles.name: Folk
styles.description: Brisker, four beats to the bar, a plucked accompaniment and a wider melody.

styles.name: Lullaby
styles.description: Very slow, a rocking arpeggio underneath, a narrow melody and a long room.

styles.name: Chant
styles.description: Plainsong: one chord held as a drone, no pulse to speak of, the words carrying the shape.

styles.name: Carol
styles.description: Brisk and bright, an arpeggio accompaniment and the widest melodic arch.
